description: Final polish, testing, and quality assurance across all features
steps: Run TypeScript compiler: `tsc --noEmit` to fix all TypeScript errors
Run all tests: `npm test` - ensure all 14+ tests pass with updated INR values
Test mobile responsiveness for all new components
Verify consistent color scheme and spacing throughout application
Test all buttons and links are functional (no placeholders)
Check all currency displays use formatINR consistently
Verify no console errors or warnings in development mode
Test build process: `npm run build` succeeds
Update README.md with new features and screenshots
acceptance_criteria: All features work correctly on mobile and desktop
No broken links or non-functional buttons
verification: Check responsive design on multiple viewport sizes
